environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2, Python 3.9, Flask via gunicorn. ImageMagick 6.9.12 installed from yum repository. Container runs as non-root user 'appuser' but with standard Linux capabilities. No additional sandboxing. The /etc/ImageMagick-6/policy.xml has default permissive policy (all coders enabled). The application process has network access and can reach the instance metadata service at 169.254.169.254.

config.imagemagick_policy: default (all coders enabled including MVG, SVG, EPHEMERAL, URL, MSL)
